posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked: I would think "destroy all cards" to be similar to "discard entire hand," in such that, if you have no cards in hand, you can discard all cards in hand, which would be no cards discarded, to still get the effect, you just can't discard a card, as there are no cards to choose..  You can destroy all cards in play even if there are no cards in play and still get the effect, you just can't destroy a card, as there are no cards to choose.
